title: Automated Prediction of Ischemic Brain Tissue Fate from Multiphase Computed Tomographic Angiography in Patients with Acute Ischemic Stroke Using Machine Learning.
summary: Machine learning predicted ischemic tissue fate from multiphase CT angiography in acute-stroke patients. The conclusion is limited to the study cohort, reference standard and validation described in the paper. External replication and prospective utility were not established.
ai_technology: Machine learning predicted ischemic tissue fate from multiphase CT angiography in acute-stroke patients.

evidence.tested: Machine learning predicted ischemic tissue fate from multiphase CT angiography in acute-stroke patients. The publisher Methods and Results were checked; this conclusion is limited to the study cohort, reference standard and validation described there.
evidence.unknown: External replication, causal effects and prospective utility were not established in the reviewed material.
